name: FFS_CHAT_MESSAGE
description: Used to store messages for the Collaboration chats.

columns.name: CHAT_ID
columns.description: Id of the chat for the message.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence number for the chat message.

columns.name: AUTHOR
columns.description: User id of the author of the message.

columns.name: SENT_TIME
columns.description: Time at which the message is sent.

columns.name: TEXT
columns.description: Actual Content Of The Sent Message.

columns.name: SYSTEM_MESSAGE
columns.description: Type of system messages. Examples are user_left, user_joined, etc. For regular messages value will be 'normal'.

columns.name: AUTHOR_TYPE
columns.description: Type of author. Values can be 0 for user, 1 for chatbot.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_EDIT_TIME
columns.description: Last time when the author edited message text.
